title: Our best evening in Barcelona!
text: We loved our evening cooking paella and chatting with our hosts. They were welcoming and generous and we enjoyed a delicious meal on the beautiful rooftop terrace. We would highly recommend this!
author: O2676PHhelenb

title: Delicious & Informative, Thank you!
text:
We had a great time at Alfonso and Txema's master class. We were welcomed into their home by them, their dog and parrot. All very friendly!

We were a group of 9 friends and another couple. The lesson was very informative, with explanations on the ingredients and techniques. There were a lot of tips that were new to most of us. We prepped the ingredients for gazpacho, a seafood paella and sangria, which were all delicious.

title: Fun group activity
text: Really fun activity to do in a group. The hosts were very welcoming, the atmosphere was fun and relaxed, and the food was excellent. Their dog was super cute and friendly  ❤️ highly recommended.
author: chloegambin

title: Delicious, fun dining experience
text: Lovely evening with delicious food and company. View from their apartment and rooftop was beautiful.
author: Casey_G

title: A Fabulous Evening
text:
This was a great experience in a stunning rooftop setting near the Barcelona seaport. It was a small group—there were five of us—at a table prepped with all the raw ingredients for a magnificent seafood paella. Our chef ensured we were hands-on in the preparation as he explained in great detail the what and how of each ingredient. But it wasn’t just paella. We also made gazpacho and a whit-wine sangria.

author: Garald_H

title: 12/10 recommend!
text: Everything was perfect! From the size of the group, to our wonderful host explaining everything in such detail, to the incredible views. I would recommend to any & everyone. What a delicious meal spent bonding with new folks!

title: Highly Recommend
text: We had a great time at the Paella Cooking class.  Alfonso's home is a perfect setting and the rooftop was amazing with al the plants and the view.

title: Wonderful experience
text: Wonderful hosts! Fantastic location and so gracious and delicious. We really enjoyed this paella evening! Muchas gracias!

title: We had a great time. Very...
text: We had a great time. Very personable hosts, Alfonso and Txema. Wonderful company and beautiful evening with excellent food.
author: Gregory_B

title: Lovely!
text: What a lovely experience—someone welcoming you into their beautiful home to learn and share over a delicious, authentic meal served in a rooftop garden oasis. Our hosts were warm and welcoming. I enjoyed learning to prepare paella and loved the anecdotes that made the cooking lesson feel personal and special. The class is great for both those who love being in the kitchen and those with no cooking experience.
